conventions: max 8 exported symbols per package (12 hard fail) — scripts/check.sh counts
doc.go per package (contract-first; the entire public API in one file)
pure core / thin shell (logic = pure functions; I/O only at store/plugin/stream/api/janitor edges)
api handlers are pure delegation: parse request -> call ONE domain function -> write response (no branching, no orchestration)
no DI framework, no reflect (golangci depguard denies both)
flat main.go constructor wiring (the entire app graph readable in one file)
data-type boundaries (structs); interfaces only at the plugin seam with >=2 implementations (never single-impl interfaces)
no shared mutable types across packages (cross-package data crosses a struct conversion)
table-driven test per exported symbol (tests are the spec AND the acceptance gate)
parameterized SQL only (no string-built queries) — golang-security skill

dependency direction points DOWN only: api -> scan -> enrich -> {module, plugin} -> store (enrich sits between scan and {module,plugin}; Phase B1: scan no longer calls enrich inline — it persists items 'pending' then hands the library to enrich.Queue via Deps.Notify post-drain; enrich never imports scan); the worker pool is a process-lifetime component; proto/ and pkg/sdk are shared leaves; no cycles
Apache-2.0 license headers on every .go file (D12/Q18); DCO Signed-off-by, no CLA
prefer deprecation over deletion (reserved fields, additive proto changes)
precision: exact per-source values namespaced and preserved (no over-rounding, no source destroys another's data)
Russian-language data is first-class (no English-only assumptions baked in)
complexity budget: file warn >300 / fail >500 lines; outgoing intra-core deps warn >4 / fail >6 per package; a failed check means redesign, not relax

internal/enrich/ — metadata-side orchestrator + async derived-queue dispatcher (arch §4.4); 7 symbols Enrich/Deps/Result + Queue/QueueConfig/Stats/NewQueue. Phase A: serial 4-RPC chain Match->BuildRequest->Convert->Merge over metadata.v1.MetadataSource; pure nextState transition function advances items.status; authoritative _provenance + recomputable _view assembly; namespace isolation enforced. Phase B1: Queue derives pending (item,plugin) work from items+namespaces+enrichment_failures ledger (NO queue table), feeds a bounded channel, a worker pool drains it under per-item in-memory leases with retry/backoff (queue.go/worker.go/lease.go/retry.go). Enrich preserved (deprecate-don't-delete, AC-3); worker shares Enrich's helpers but does not call Enrich directly. D-Q1: queueable iff AuthMode != CLIENT (empty/SERVER queued, CLIENT excluded). The metadata-side analog of internal/scan

plugins/base-scanner/ — scanner subprocess binary (MAIN module for MVP) using pkg/sdk: walk + ffprobe arg-slice + withinRoot path guard. Phase A: media-type-agnostic (parseTV extracted to tv-parser; Identify stamps only base fields). Phase B2: image.go — module-type-gated discovery (module_type=='image' => imageMime jpg/jpeg/png/webp/heic/heif, else video mediaMime; NOT a union filter) + probeImage stdlib image.DecodeConfig base info (jpeg/png dims only; webp/heic/heif/RAW soft-fail — exiftool supplies their data at enrichment). Serves scanner.v1 + plugin.v1

plugins/tv-parser/ — metadata_source subprocess binary (NEW in Phase A): parseTV/cleanTitle/parentDir/atoi + 4 regexes moved verbatim from base-scanner; serves metadata.v1.MetadataSource (Match->BuildRequest->Convert->Merge) + plugin.v1 on one gRPC server via sdk.Serve

plugins/image-enricher/ — metadata_source subprocess binary (NEW in Phase B2): structural mirror of tv-parser; only the capability body differs (EXIF extraction vs filename parse). Convert invokes the SYSTEM exiftool binary via os/exec arg-slice (-j -n <selected tags> <absPath>, NEVER a shell — mirrors ffprobe.go); maps ImageWidth/Height/FileType/Make/Model/DateTimeOriginal/Orientation/GPSLatitude/GPSLongitude. Match carries absolute_path; Merge writes sources['image-enricher'] only. NO new Go dep (exiftool = runtime dep). Every exiftool failure is a per-source SOFT-FAIL (empty namespace -> B1 no_data -> settle, AC-6). Serves metadata.v1.MetadataSource + plugin.v1 on one gRPC server via sdk.Serve
